validation.method: Re-read each of six proposal files and pinned I1 source parts; exact source blob SHA, before fields and all unchanged top-level protected values; only opening/followup changed; speaker index bounds, nonempty Korean/English, differing first branch line. Union of R3/R5/R6/R7/R8 patch indices reconstructed independently.

limitations: New 100 proposals meet minimum, 83 remain to reach recommended scope. 12 existing-ID revisions excluded from unique increment.

Korean and English editorial proposals are scene-specific; many share administrative/correction interaction patterns, and fixed cast, venue or choices may still cue answers. Exact replay is structural, not proof of naturalness or playtest.
R3 history holds 41 and old history holds 8 retained pending Q2-C approval. No independently verified historical change.
Story ranking uses date interval and incoming-edge collision heuristic; semantic and runtime checks remain required. Three same-day chains stay held.
No source/engine modification, runtime tests, main merge, or deployment.
